integrity: Rational two-state transition witnesses are fully specified in RESULT.md; exact-arithmetic checks are included in checker.py. No assertion of independent certification is made.
limitations: The classification is exact for two-state machines with nonnegative determinants. It does not classify unrestricted two-state machines that use orientation-reversing transitions. The isolated-word gap is not optimized, and independent validation is not performed.
title: Exact maximizers of order-preserving two-state probabilistic automata
